en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5454 - Abd Al-Ṣamad ibn Muhammad narrated from Hanan ibn Sadir from his father, from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said:

"I entered upon Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Hanafiyya, and his tongue had become paralyzed.
I instructed him to make his will, but he did not respond.

So, I ordered a basin to be brought and filled it with sand.
I said to him, 'Write with your hand,' and he wrote his will in the sand with his hand, and I copied it onto a scroll."
